translations.idiomatic: At the emperor's personal southern suburb sacrifice, the principal correlate trays do not distinguish left and right sides, noble and humble, or pig versus body dismemberment.

sentences.zh: 請郊廟薦腥，解其牲兩髀、兩肩、兩肋並脊為七體，左右胖俱用。

translations.literal: It is requested that for suburban and temple raw offerings the victim be dismembered into two thighs, two shoulders, two ribs, and the spine as seven parts, using both left and right sides.
translations.idiomatic: It was requested that for suburban and temple raw offerings the victim be divided into two thighs, two shoulders, two ribs, and the spine—seven parts in all—with both left and right sides used.

sentences.zh: 其載於俎，以兩髀在端，兩肩、兩肋次之，脊居中，皆進末。

translations.literal: When loaded on the tray, the two thighs are at the ends, the two shoulders and two ribs next, the spine in the center—all presented end foremost.
translations.idiomatic: On the tray the two thighs go at the ends, shoulders and ribs next, the spine in the center—all presented end foremost.

sentences.zh: 至薦熟，沉肉于湯，止用右胖。

translations.literal: For cooked offerings the meat is steeped in broth; only the right side is used.
translations.idiomatic: For cooked offerings the meat is steeped in broth and only the right side is used.

sentences.zh: 髀不升俎，前後肱骨離為三，曰肩、臂、臑。

translations.literal: The thighs do not ascend the tray; the front and rear arm bones are separated into three parts called shoulder, arm, and shank.
translations.idiomatic: The thighs do not go on the tray; the front and rear arm bones are separated into shoulder, arm, and shank.

sentences.zh: 後髀股骨去體離為二，曰肫、胳。

translations.literal: The rear thigh and femur are separated from the body into two parts called shank and rib-flap.
translations.idiomatic: The rear thigh and femur are separated from the body into shank and rib-flap.

sentences.zh: 前脊謂之正脊，次直謂之脡脊，闊於脡脊謂之橫脊，皆二骨。

translations.literal: The front spine is called the main spine, the next straight section the thigh spine, and the section wider than the thigh spine the cross spine—each of two bones.
translations.idiomatic: The front spine is the main spine, the next section the thigh spine, and the wider section the cross spine—each of two bones.

sentences.zh: 肋骨最後二為短肋，旁中二為正肋，最前二為代肋。

translations.literal: The last two ribs are short ribs, the middle two on the side are main ribs, and the foremost two are substitute ribs.
translations.idiomatic: The last two ribs are short ribs, the middle two on the side are main ribs, and the foremost two are substitute ribs.

sentences.zh: 若升俎，則肩、臂臑在上端，膊、胳在下端，脊、肋在中央。

translations.literal: If ascending the tray, shoulder, arm, and shank are at the upper end, rib-flap and shank-flap at the lower end, spine and ribs in the center.
translations.idiomatic: On the tray, shoulder, arm, and shank go at the upper end, rib-flap and shank-flap at the lower end, spine and ribs in the center.

sentences.zh: 其俎之序，則肩、臂、臑、正脊、脡脊、橫脊、代肋、長肋、短肋、膊、胳凡十一體，而骨體升俎，進神坐前如少牢禮，皆進下。

translations.literal: The order on the tray is shoulder, arm, shank, main spine, thigh spine, cross spine, substitute rib, long rib, short rib, rib-flap, and shank-flap—eleven parts in all; when bone parts ascend the tray they are presented before the spirit seat as in the Lesser Penance rite, all presented lower end first.
translations.idiomatic: The tray order is shoulder, arm, shank, main spine, thigh spine, cross spine, substitute rib, long rib, short rib, rib-flap, and shank-flap—eleven parts; bone parts are presented before the spirit seat as in the Lesser Penance rite, all lower end first.

sentences.zh: 其牲體各預以半為腥俎，半為熟俎，腸胃膚俎亦然。」

translations.literal: Each victim body is beforehand divided half for raw tray and half for cooked tray; intestine, stomach, and skin trays are likewise.'
translations.idiomatic: Each victim is divided in advance: half for the raw tray and half for the cooked tray; intestine, stomach, and skin trays follow the same rule.'

sentences.zh: 又請：「親祠飲福酒訖，仿《儀禮》'佐食摶黍'之說，命太官令取忝於簋，摶以授祝，祝受以豆，以嘏乎皇帝而無嘏辭。

translations.literal: It is also requested: 'After the blessing wine at personal sacrifice, following the Ceremonial Rites account of the assistant kneading millet, order the chief cook to take millet from the grain vessel, knead it, and give it to the invoker; the invoker receives it in a dou and offers blessing to the emperor without a blessing formula.
translations.idiomatic: It was also requested: 'After the blessing wine at personal sacrifice, following the Ceremonial Rites account of the assistant kneading millet, the chief cook should take millet from the grain vessel, knead it, and give it to the invoker; the invoker receives it in a dou and offers blessing to the emperor without a blessing formula.

sentences.zh: 又本朝親祠南郊，習儀於壇所，明堂習儀於大慶殿，皆近於瀆。

translations.literal: Moreover, in this dynasty personal sacrifice at the southern suburb rehearses at the altar site, and the Bright Hall rehearses at the Great Celebration Hall—both too close and irreverent.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, personal southern suburb sacrifice rehearses at the altar site and the Bright Hall at the Great Celebration Hall—both too close to the spirits and irreverent.

sentences.zh: 伏請南郊習儀於青城，明堂習儀於尚書省，以遠神為恭。

translations.literal: I humbly request that southern suburb rehearsal be at Qingcheng and Bright Hall rehearsal at the Department of State Affairs, keeping distant from the spirits as reverence.
translations.idiomatic: I request that southern suburb rehearsal be held at Qingcheng and Bright Hall rehearsal at the Department of State Affairs, keeping a respectful distance from the spirits.

sentences.zh: 又賜胙：三師，三公，侍中，中書令，門下、中書侍郎，尚書左、右丞，知樞密、同知院事，禮儀、儀仗、鹵簿、頓遞使，牛羊豕肩、臂、臑各五；

translations.literal: Sacrificial meat is also granted: to the Three Preceptors, Three Excellencies, palace attendants, secretaries of the Secretariat, vice directors of the Secretariat, left and right vice directors of the Ministries, Bureau of Military Affairs directors and vice directors, and the ritual protocol, ceremonial arms, insignia, and relay commissioners—ox, sheep, and pig shoulder, arm, and shank, five each;
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial meat is granted as follows: to the Three Preceptors, Three Excellencies, palace attendants, secretaries of the Secretariat, vice directors of the Secretariat, left and right vice directors of the Ministries, Bureau of Military Affairs directors and vice directors, and the ritual protocol, ceremonial arms, insignia, and relay commissioners—ox, sheep, and pig shoulder, arm, and shank, five each;

sentences.zh: 太子三師、三少，特進，觀文大學士、學士，御史大夫，六尚書，金紫、銀青光祿大夫，節度使，資政殿大學士，觀文翰林資政端明龍圖天章寶文承旨、侍講、侍讀，學士，左右散騎常侍，尚書列曹侍郎，龍圖、天章、寶文直學士，光祿、正議、通議大夫，御史中丞，太子賓客、詹事，給事中，中書舍人，節度觀察留後，左右諫議，龍圖、天章、寶文待制，太中、中大夫，秘書、殿中丞，太常、宗正卿，牛豕肩、臂、臑各三；

translations.literal: to crown prince's three preceptors and three mentors, special advancement, palace academician grandees and academicians, censor-in-chief, six ministers, gold and purple and silver and blue grandees of splendid virtue, military commissioners, grand academician of the Hall for Cherishing Governance, palace Hanlin and other academician titles, left and right regular palace attendants, ministry vice directors, dragon diagram and heavenly chapter and treasured text academicians, grandees of splendid virtue, censor-in-chief, crown prince guests and mentors, drafting edict officials, military observation deputies, left and right remonstrators, dragon diagram and heavenly chapter and treasured text academicians in attendance, grand and middle grandees, secretariat and palace directors, directors of imperial sacrifices and imperial clansmanship—ox and pig shoulder, arm, and shank, three each;
translations.idiomatic: to the crown prince's three preceptors and three mentors, specially advanced officials, palace academician grandees and academicians, the censor-in-chief, the six ministers, grandees of splendid virtue, military commissioners, the grand academician of the Hall for Cherishing Governance, and the various palace and Hanlin academician titles, left and right regular palace attendants, ministry vice directors, dragon diagram and related academicians, grandees, the censor-in-chief, crown prince guests and mentors, drafting edict officials, military observation deputies, remonstrators, related academicians in attendance, grand and middle grandees, secretariat and palace directors, and directors of imperial sacrifices and imperial clansmanship—ox and pig shoulder, arm, and shank, three each;

sentences.zh: 入內內侍省押班、副都知，光祿卿，監禮官，博士，牛羊脊、肋各三；

translations.literal: to inner-palace eunuch bureau squad leaders and deputy directors, director of imperial entertainments, supervising ritual officials, and doctors—ox and sheep spine and ribs, three each;
translations.idiomatic: to inner-palace eunuch squad leaders and deputy directors, the director of imperial entertainments, supervising ritual officials, and doctors—ox and sheep spine and ribs, three each;

sentences.zh: 太祝，奉禮，司奠彝，郊社、太廟、宮闈令，監牲牢、供應祠事內官，羊髀、膊、胳三；

translations.literal: to grand invokers, ritual attendants, directors of ritual vessels, directors of suburban altars, grand temple, and palace gates, eunuchs supervising victims and supplying sacrifices—sheep thigh, rib-flap, and shank-flap, three each;
translations.idiomatic: to grand invokers, ritual attendants, directors of ritual vessels, directors of suburban altars, grand temple, and palace gates, and eunuchs supervising victims and sacrifices—sheep thigh, rib-flap, and shank-flap, three each;

sentences.zh: 應執事、職掌、樂工、門幹、宰手、馭馬、馭車人，並均給脾、肫、胳、觳及腸、胃、膚之類。」

translations.literal: all attending officials, duty officers, musicians, gate stewards, butchers, horse and carriage handlers are equally given spleen, shank, rib-flap, shell, and intestine, stomach, and skin portions.'
translations.idiomatic: all attending officials, duty officers, musicians, gate stewards, butchers, and horse and carriage handlers receive equal shares of spleen, shank, rib-flap, shell, and intestine, stomach, and skin portions.'

sentences.zh: 慶曆元年，判太常寺呂公綽言：「舊禮，郊廟尊罍數皆准古，而不實三酒、五齊、明水、明酒，有司相承，名為'看器'。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qingli, Lü Gongchuo, acting director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, said: 'Under the old rites, the number of zun and lei vessels at suburban altars and temples all followed antiquity, yet the three wines, five fermentations, clear water, and clear wine were not actually filled; the responsible offices perpetuated the practice, calling them 'display vessels'.
translations.idiomatic: In Qingli 1 (1041), Lü Gongchuo, acting director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, said: 'Under the old rites, the number of zun and lei vessels at suburban altars and temples followed antiquity, yet the three wines, five fermentations, clear water, and clear wine were not actually filled; the responsible offices perpetuated the practice, calling them 'display vessels'.

sentences.zh: 郊廟配位惟用祠祭酒，分大、中祠位二升，小祠位一升，止一尊酌獻、一尊飲福。

translations.literal: At suburban altars and temples, associated positions used only sacrificial wine; major and middle sacrifices received two sheng per position, minor sacrifices one sheng, with only one zun for libation and one for the blessing wine.
translations.idiomatic: At suburban altars and temples, associated positions used only sacrificial wine: major and middle sacrifices received two sheng per position and minor sacrifices one sheng, with only one zun for libation and one for the blessing wine.

sentences.zh: 宜詔酒官依法制齊、酒，分實之壇殿上下尊罍，有司毋設空器；

translations.literal: The wine office should be ordered to prepare fermentations and wines according to law, filling the upper and lower zun and lei on the altar and in the hall; the responsible offices should not set out empty vessels;
translations.idiomatic: The wine office should be ordered to prepare fermentations and wines according to law, filling the upper and lower zun and lei on the altar and in the hall; the responsible offices should not set out empty vessels;

sentences.zh: 並如唐制以井水代明水、明酒；

translations.literal: and, as in the Tang system, use well water in place of clear water and clear wine;
translations.idiomatic: and, as in the Tang system, use well water in place of clear water and clear wine;

sentences.zh: 正配位酌獻、飲福酒，用酒二升者各增二升，從祀神位用舊升數。」

translations.literal: for principal correlate positions at libation and blessing wine, where two sheng of wine were used, each should be increased by two sheng, while associated spirit positions should use the old measures.'
translations.idiomatic: for principal correlate positions at libation and blessing wine, where two sheng of wine were used, each should be increased by two sheng, while associated spirit positions should use the old measures.'
